name: @keep-lts/ip
author: Fedor Indutny <fedor@indutny.com>
description: Security-maintained drop-in fork of ip. Patches CVE-2024-29415 (SSRF): isPublic/isPrivate/isLoopback now classify the parsed address bytes, so 127.1, 0177.0.0.1, ::ffff:7f00:1, ::ffff:a9fe:a9fe and other spellings of private addresses are no longer reported as public. Original API unchanged.
